name: Glass Wall Garden Room
description: Bright modern living room. The long north wall is floor-to-ceiling glass with thin wood mullions in a four-by-two grid and a low wood bench along its base. Dark-framed sliding glass doors fill the west wall from the northwest corner. The east and south walls are solid white, with a 36 by 80 in entry door on the south wall. Gray-washed wood plank floor and a flat white ceiling. A simple garden plane sits outside the glass.
